name: Tasershot loads into an unloaded Gun weapon
notes: Tasershot's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost is 0 so materializing via a direct FSM click is free. Framework Sidearm (a REGALIA,WEAPON with the GUN subtype and no Subcards, i.e. unloaded) is seeded onto the field as the [REST] Load ability's target, same pattern as penetrator-round-load-gun/anathemas-end-load-gun/incendiary-shot-load-gun. Only the always-available Load half is covered; the [Class Bonus] On Champion Hit level-up-punish trigger requires a real combat hit and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Renewable [REST]: Load CARDNAME into target unloaded Gun weapon you control.
